verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud infrastructure provider (on-demand instances, clusters, managed Kubernetes and Slurm), not an agent or AI assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. The community item [lambda-labs-comm-3] describes an unofficial MCP server that lets agents control Lambda, which is the server role. It does not show Lambda itself plugging in MCP servers, so it does not make this axis applicable.
